claim: A user cannot refund an order belonging to another user; the request must return 403.
A refund request with no X-User-Id header must return 401 or 422, never a successful response.
A refund request from an unknown user must return 401.
A 403 error response on the refund endpoint must not expose the target order's internal data.
A user cannot change the status of another user's order by calling the refund endpoint.
